title: An integral that ignores a dense set
promptMarkdown: Enumerate $\mathbb Q\cap[0,1]=\{q_1,q_2,\ldots\}$ and let $f_n=1_{\{q_1,\ldots,q_n\}}$. Find the pointwise limit, prove measurability of the limit, and compute all integrals. Explain why the limit is not Riemann integrable although every $f_n$ is.
hintLadder: Write the limit as an indicator of a countable set.
Compare upper and lower Darboux sums using density of both rationals and irrationals.

criteria.criterion: Identifies and proves measurability of the pointwise limit.
